evidence.source: Contract 218 reached Development on 24 August 2026 THROUGH THE FAST LANE, which is worth recording because it is the first contract in this sequence the fast lane could carry. Contracts 214 to 217 could not use it: `supabase db push` is all-or-nothing, so contract 217's `drop function` at the top of the queue blocked the three additive migrations underneath it and they all took the guarded lane instead. With Development at 217 and 218 the only thing pending, and 218 additive, the cheap lane applied on its own terms. EVERYTHING BELOW IS A SEPARATE READ-ONLY QUERY taken at 2026-08-24T11:03:45.635050+00, not the rollout job's own output. THE LEDGER HOLDS 218 ROWS AND NAMES 20260824100000 live_results_channel. Contract 218 is driven rather than read off the ledger: `public.matches` is on the `supabase_realtime` publication, THE PUBLICATION CARRIES THAT TABLE AND NOTHING ELSE, and `matches` keeps replica identity `d`. All three are the contract's own claims. The second matters most: ADR 0008 accepted a narrow live-results channel and REJECTED subscribing to broad user-owned or scoring tables, so a publication that had grown a second table would be the finding rather than a detail. The third is the deliberate one — FULL would put the pre-update row image in every message, which is more exposure and more traffic for nothing nobody reads, because the browser refetches from get_leaderboard rather than consuming the payload. Protected state is unmoved across the contract: 24 auth users, 24 profiles, 34 entries, 64 season predictions, 756 match predictions, 5 leagues, 39 league members, 578 season fixtures, 51 matches, 2 reminder deliveries and 0 push subscriptions. Cron jobs stay at 15 — contract 218 schedules nothing. Both AI publication gates are false and Euro publication is still hidden; the fixture histogram is unchanged at played 12, postponed 5, scheduled 561. Contract 217 survives underneath: `claim_due_reminders(integer, boolean)` is still executable by `service_role` and by neither `authenticated` nor `anon`, and the reminder sender is still inert with `secrets_present` false and `not-configured` its only recorded outcome. NOTHING WAS SENT AND NO PAID PROVIDER CALL WAS MADE. No Production mutation is claimed by this record.
